answer: Vancouver is a major city in Western Canada, located in the Lower Mainland region of British Columbia. Vancouver is one of the most ethnically and linguistically diverse cities in Canada: 49.3 percent of its residents are not native English speakers, 47.8 percent are native speakers of neither English nor French, and 54.5 percent of residents belong to visible minority groups. In terms of housing affordability, Vancouver is also one of the most expensive cities in Canada and in the world.
